units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 70:10">Gen. R. s. 70</cite> (play on <he>מחרן</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 29:4">Gen. XXIX, 4</cite>) <he>מחֲרוֹנוֹ של וכ׳</he> we flee from the anger of the Lord; Yalk. ib. 123.

<cite ref="Zevachim 102a:10">Zeb. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>כל חרון אף וכ׳</he> wherever in the Scriptures the expression ‘anger of the Lord’ is used, there remains a lasting mark of it; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 173:1">Yalk. Ex. 173</cite>.
